author: julian.leistad
name: oki10
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Silk style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#0B1026, #3D46E8, #B18CFF, #FFD6E7). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
